authorization: One bounded last attempt authorized by the project owner; stop if development gate fails. No merge/main update.

candidate_definitions.no_share: Legacy eta=0.1, alpha=0; initial legacy prior retained
candidate_definitions.decreasing_share: Legacy eta=0.1; alpha_k=1/(k+1), k begins at one arrived feedback; engineering ablation, not a claimed optimal switching schedule
candidate_definitions.adahedge: Uniform initial expert prior; eta=ln(2)/cumulative mixability gap, infinity before nonzero gap; recalculate cumulative exponential weights after each arrived feedback event. Paper equations 8-9 and Figure 1; arrival-order adapter without a delay-free guarantee.
candidate_definitions.ftl: Uniform on the cumulative arrived-loss leaders, exact tie averaging; allows endpoint forecasts

selection: Minimum equal-seed/equal-entity MAE across exactly four candidates; declared candidate order breaks exact ties
proceed_gate: Selected candidate MAE must be strictly lower than Fixed, static and legacy in the old Development aggregate. If not, stop this attempt without training a new cohort.
oracle: Hindsight per-entity static and daily expert oracle; diagnostic only, excluded from selection and deployment.
confirmation_if_proceed: Separate committed new-ID/cohort/objective lock before any selected vector; at most ten IDs per eligible namespace; exclude all prior recorded uses and issue121 additional exposure. Primary both 97.5% intervals lower endpoints >0 for adaptive vs Fixed/static, same equal-namespace, 7-day calendar/entity 10000 bootstrap; no replacement or repeat search.
limits: Development candidate comparison is exploratory and not confirmation
Previously exposed issue119 cohort is excluded from candidate selection
Same saved experts; no new backbone, source pretraining or lambda update
Delayed feedback adapter does not inherit the paper guarantee automatically
